basic_info.description:
Living your best life in San Francisco. Welcome to 400 Grove St #405.
This urban property was designed by award winning architecture Ann Fougeron. 
Located in the heart of Hayes Valley, where you can walk to your favorite restaurants,shopping, theater and much more. 400 Grove unit #405 boasts of many high end design finishes throughout. Beautiful wide plank oak floors, soaring 9 ft ceiling and large windows. SieMatic kitchen with Corian counters and Bosch Liebherr appliances. Open concept,living and dining room, a spacious master bedroom and walk-in closet. 2 bed and 2 baths,in unit unit W/D, 1 car deeded parking.
Rooftop,  W/BBQ and VIEWS, Bamboo central courtyard and a virtual doorman.
